name: nudge-tray
description: Nudge — tells you when Claude Code is waiting on you
author: Nudge

scripts.bundle: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --outfile=dist/index.cjs --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --target=node20 && npm run bundle:engine && npm run copy-assets
scripts.pack: npm run check-electron-pin && npm run bundle && electron-builder --dir
scripts.dist: npm run check-electron-pin && npm run bundle && electron-builder
scripts.check-electron-pin: node -e "const v=require('electron/package.json').version;const y=require('node:fs').readFileSync('electron-builder.yml','utf8');if(!y.includes('electronVersion: '+v))throw new Error('electron-builder.yml electronVersion drifted from installed electron '+v)"
